clue.text: Request a little money to get ring

parts.note: P stands for a penny, a small sum of British money
a peal is a ringing of bells

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a small loan so they can buy a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: To appeal is to ask earnestly, a plea or entreaty.

clue.text: Harbour with a lagoon opening to form grand entrance

parts.note: a port is a harbour

indicators.note: opening means only the first letter of lagoon is used

explanation.surface: A harbour with a lagoon makes an impressive way in.
explanation.definitionFit: A portal is an imposing doorway or gateway.

clue.text: Avoid notice in prank

indicators.note: in puts the notice inside the word for avoid

parts.note: to escape something is to avoid it
an ad is an advertisement, a notice

explanation.surface: Someone tries to go unnoticed during a practical joke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notice' looks like a verb but is the noun AD.
explanation.definitionFit: An escapade is a reckless or mischievous adventure, a prank.

clue.text: Party time noted as being free from restraint

parts.note: Lib is short for Liberal, a political party
an era is a period of time
noted is read as given a note, here TE, a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A party celebrates a period known for freedom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'noted' means the time gets a musical note added after it.
explanation.definitionFit: To liberate is to set free, release from captivity.

clue.text: Threshold some animals cross coming back

indicators.note: coming back tells us the whole string of pieces is read from right to left

parts.note: household animals kept for company are pets
a rood is a cross, as in a church's rood screen

explanation.surface: Animals keep crossing the threshold and returning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' turns PETS ROOD into DOORSTEP: ROOD gives DOOR and PETS gives STEP.
explanation.definitionFit: The step at a house's front entrance is its threshold.

clue.text: Put wine in river — that eases the tension

indicators.note: in tells us the wine goes inside the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
tent is a dark red Spanish wine

explanation.surface: Pouring wine into a river relaxes everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Détente is a relaxing of strained relations between nations.

clue.text: Helping almost everyone, within reason

parts.note: a ration is a portion or helping

indicators.note: almost means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: everyone is all

explanation.surface: A portion for nearly everyone, within sensible limits.
explanation.definitionFit: Rational means logical, guided by sense.

clue.text: Spell in America brought to an end

parts.note: a term is a spell or period of time
US is the United States of America

explanation.surface: A stint in the United States comes to its close.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminus is the end of a line, a final point.

clue.text: Chips, say, after serving expert

definitions.meaning: Mr Chips is the schoolmaster of Goodbye, Mr Chips; one who has finished serving is a former master

explanation.walkthrough: 'Chips' suggests fried potatoes; it is Mr Chips, the fictional teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: A past master is someone thoroughly skilled at something.

clue.text: Missile of reliable type used by flier

parts.note: a dependable, good-hearted person is called a brick
a bat is a flying mammal

explanation.surface: A dependable sort of projectile is used by an airman.
explanation.definitionFit: A brickbat is a piece of brick thrown as a weapon, hence any missile or insult.

clue.text: Goggles used in flight, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly signals that a word heard spoken gives the entry

parts.note: a flight is a set of stairs

explanation.surface: Protective eyewear worn on an aeroplane, so they say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Goggles' looks like a noun for eyewear but is the verb to gape.
explanation.definitionFit: To goggle is to gaze wide-eyed, so goggles means gapes or gazes.

clue.text: Relatively advantageous form of dishonesty

parts.note: 'Relatively' is read as 'to one's relatives': a corrupt practice that benefits family members

explanation.definitionFit: Favouritism shown to kin in giving jobs is a form of corruption benefiting relations.

clue.text: Charming lake in rustic surroundings

indicators.note: surroundings says the rustic's word goes round the lake's letter

parts.note: a rustic is a country person, a peasant
L is the standard abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A delightful lake set in rural countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasant means agreeable or likeable, as a charming person is.

clue.text: In which circulation through the grounds is facilitated

definitions.text: In which circulation through the grounds is facilitated

parts.words: In which circulation through the grounds is facilitated
parts.note: 'grounds' suggests estates but means coffee grounds, through which water circulates when brewing

explanation.definitionFit: A coffee pot passes boiling water repeatedly through ground beans.

clue.text: Surrendered after soldiers withdrew

indicators.note: after places the word for surrendered behind the soldiers

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
ceded means gave up or surrendered

explanation.surface: Troops yielded and then pulled back.
explanation.definitionFit: Receded means went back or retreated.

clue.text: Gives tips to barmen

explanation.walkthrough: 'barmen' suggests pub staff, but means barristers.
explanation.definitionFit: To counsel is to advise; counsels are barristers.

clue.text: Lining up in the army for treatment of wounds

definitions.meaning: soldiers dress ranks by aligning themselves
a covering applied to a wound

explanation.definitionFit: Dressing is military alignment, and a bandage for a wound.

clue.text: Firmly established like Elsie and her sisters?

definitions.meaning: in Alice in Wonderland the Dormouse tells of three sisters, Elsie, Lacie and Tillie, who lived at the bottom of a treacle well

explanation.walkthrough: Read as a phrase, the entry describes the Dormouse's sisters, placed in a well.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-set describes something solidly fixed or firmly built.

clue.text: First story on way getting attention for a start

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the story above the way

parts.note: to lend an ear is to pay attention
a lie is a false story
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: An early tale on the street gets noticed first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a start' puts the attention word EAR first.
explanation.definitionFit: Earliest means first in time.

clue.text: One laden awkwardly is put under pressure

indicators.note: awkwardly signals that one and laden are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A heavily loaded person is strained by the burden.
explanation.definitionFit: To be leaned on is to be pressured or coerced.

clue.text: Assigned place in media broadcast when article is dropped

indicators.note: in puts the place word inside the rest
broadcast means scattered, the letters rearranged
is dropped means the article is removed

parts.note: A is the indefinite article
to put is to place

explanation.surface: A location in the news reports when a story is cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is dropped' leaves MEDI, which 'broadcast' rearranges to IMED; 'place' looks like a noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Imputed means attributed or ascribed to someone.

clue.text: Cartographer marks with special care Western peak

parts.note: M abbreviates the mark, the old German currency

indicators.note: special indicates the letters of care are made into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, typical of Dartmoor and the West Country

explanation.surface: A mapmaker carefully annotates a peak in the west.
explanation.definitionFit: Gerardus Mercator was the Flemish mapmaker whose projection is still used.

clue.text: Means to get in with leading batsman

definitions.meaning: a tool for opening something, like a tin
in cricket, one of the first two batters

explanation.definitionFit: An opener is a device for opening, and a first-wicket batter.

clue.text: Desires better position in field

parts.note: longs means yearns or desires
to top is to better or beat

explanation.surface: Someone wants a better place on the playing field.
explanation.walkthrough: LONG STOP is a cricket fielding position behind the wicketkeeper, near the boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: A fielding position in cricket, directly behind the wicketkeeper.

clue.text: Fellow's input to reflective model dissertation

indicators.note: input to means the fellow's piece is put inside the other piece
reflective means the word for model appears mirrored, read backwards

parts.note: to sit is to pose as an artist's model
fellow's is HE'S, he is

explanation.surface: A man contributes to a thoughtful model essay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflective' gives TIS, and 'Fellow's' is read as the contraction for 'he is', not a possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesis is a long academic essay submitted for a degree.

clue.text: Taking steps to produce wine

definitions.meaning: grapes were traditionally crushed underfoot to make wine

explanation.definitionFit: Treading is walking, and also crushing grapes by foot in winemaking.

clue.text: Bowing shown by notation in instrumental part

indicators.note: in places the notation word inside the instrumental part

parts.note: a reed is the vibrating part of a wind instrument
a sign is a written symbol in notation

explanation.surface: A musician's bowing marks are written into the instrumental part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bowing' suggests a violinist's technique, but means submitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Resigned means accepting or submitting, as bowing to the inevitable.

clue.text: Some hard nuts returning to Arctic wastes

indicators.note: returning means the extracted letters are read from right to left
some means only part of the words hard nuts is taken

explanation.surface: Tough characters go back to the frozen north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks ARDNUT from 'hard nuts' and 'returning' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Tundra is the treeless frozen plain of the Arctic regions.
